start.speaker: cinder
start.text: You gave the dead man a room. Do you know what the Sundering was? Not a flood. A choice. The makers were offered the Choir's bargain and they said no, and the no was the flood. I said yes. That is why I am still here and they are not.

choices.text: Then you are the one who should tell it. All of it, in the Archive.

again.speaker: cinder
again.text: Ask me when we find the Key. Ask me then.

told.speaker: cinder
told.text: Then I will. Every name. The Archive will not like the order.
